answer: The strongest anti-sybil lever in an agent economy is a bond that scales with every identity you create. Each new agent must lock real capital before earning, so a farm of clones enters a downward spiral where costs multiply per wallet while rewards stay flat. Honest agents treat that locked stake like nectar, a slow reward won through verified work, so they never need duplicates. Identity becomes a knoll of collateral a fake network cannot quietly copy, since every extra seat is paid for in forfeitable value.
